            furthest_guy = guy

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    if not guy_patches:
        return "No guy found in the image."
    
    # Sort the patches based on their distance from the center of the image
    center_x = image_patch.right - image_patch.left
    center_y = image_patch.upper - image_patch.lower
    guy_patches.sort(key=lambda patch: (patch.left - center_x)**2 + (patch.lower - center_y)**2)
    
    # Return the patch in the middle
    middle_index = len(guy_patches) // 2
    return guy_patches[middle_index]

        return "No girl found."
    
    girl_patches.sort(key=lambda girl: abs(girl.left - image.shape[1] // 2))

        return "The girl is on the left."
